summary: P3 Security Spec Mining shadow implementation is coherent, correctly bounded, and safe to mark complete. The 13-predicate finite DSL registry is exact and immutable. Deterministic-first mining and the ProposalEngine prevent model-supplied facts, subjects, scopes, evidence, parameters, or activation authority. Only qualification-backed stable specs compile in shadow; conflict, stale-dependency, empty-scope, unknown-field, unresolved-evidence, and broken-hash cases fail closed. CAS/SQLite storage is atomic and narrowly scoped. The shadow manifest is frozen and reused read-only by default/resume/maintain/alert-verify, with active_product_effect hardcoded to none. Candidate Ledger, Proof Kernel, Finding-root, and TerminalAuthority are untouched by the security spec subsystem; legacy SemanticModeler remains the live product input. The Web Review Center is read-only without trusted reviewer identity, and import is strict all-or-nothing dry-run. Qualification meets all P3 thresholds and the reviewed candidate matches the qualification manifest exactly.

non_blocking_findings.title: Compiler accepts multiple stable revisions of the same spec_uid without deduplication
non_blocking_findings.evidence: zscope/semantics/security_specs/compiler.py compile() iterates all input specs; _specs_conflict() returns false for the same spec_uid. A direct caller passing revision 1 and revision 2 of the same spec_uid produces two compiled entries. The normal shadow path indexes by uid/revision/hash and the store enforces contiguous revisions, so duplicate UIDs cannot enter through the current mining path.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Before P5 authority cutover, deduplicate same-spec_uid compiler inputs by retaining only the highest revision. Safe to defer to P4/P5.

non_blocking_findings.title: Qualification corpus uses three synthetic project styles; real-project diversity validation is deferred to P5
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The qualification manifest covers callback_service, procedural_runtime, and raii_library with a counting fake client and no network. It exercises schema and registry behavior but is not a scan of production codebases.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: The P5 deployment gate should include at least one real-project qualification sweep before authority cutover. The synthetic qualification is sufficient for P3 shadow approval.

checks.name: finite DSL and parameter registry
checks.evidence: zscope/semantics/security_specs/registry.py defines exactly the 13 operations frozen by contracts.md; exact parameter-key, slot syntax and finite enum checks reject query code and free predicates.

checks.name: strict immutable contracts and state machine
checks.evidence: canonical.py recomputes content seals; models.py validates exact fields and allowed transitions; store.py enforces contiguous revisions and transition legality before insertion.

checks.name: deterministic-first bounded model proposals
checks.evidence: miner.py keeps free LLM claims as observations, constructs system-provided SPECPROP IDs and rejects unknown selections; models.py prevents LLM-origin specs from activating.

checks.name: qualification-backed stable-only compiler
checks.evidence: compiler.py excludes non-stable, unqualified, unresolved-evidence, stale-dependency and conflicting specs, recording explicit exclusion reasons.

checks.name: atomic CAS and precise invalidation
checks.evidence: store.py uses temporary file, fsync and atomic replace with collision detection; scope/dependency/caller reverse indexes drive affected_spec_uids and invalidation_impact.

checks.name: frozen shadow workflow reuse
checks.evidence: manifest.py verifies the frozen root identity and all artifact refs; parallel_analyzer fast/replay and alert_verifier use the read-only loader. Stable replay records no outcome, view, progress, terminal-count or proof-decision drift.

checks.name: authority boundaries remain unchanged
checks.evidence: SecuritySpec has no imports into Candidate Ledger or Proof/terminal authority packages; lifecycle.py fixes mode to shadow and shadow.py reports active_product_effect=none while legacy semantic modeling remains active.

checks.name: one terminal event per cluster
checks.evidence: decision_trace.py attaches SecuritySpec identity to the existing terminal event and preserves terminal deduplication; qualification replay confirms terminal_event_count_changed=false.

checks.name: read-only Web Review Center
checks.evidence: web/server.py and web/services.py return 403 reviewer_identity_unavailable for review/apply-import; dry-run import reports applied=false and has no store mutation path.

checks.name: strict archive import and isolated exports
checks.evidence: archive.py rejects duplicate keys/UIDs, stale store revisions, invalid bundle hashes, unknown sheets/columns and broken review chains; SecuritySpec export paths do not call the loose user workbook mutation service.

checks.name: package and forbidden dependency gates
checks.evidence: The wheel includes five SecuritySpec schemas and the qualification artifact; package/lifecycle gates report no Benchmark, truth, Scorer, Candidate, validation or reporting authority dependency.

checks.name: design and qualification evidence
checks.evidence: All design-manifest document hashes matched during the review. Qualification records 143 cases, recall 1.0, unsupported 0.0, safe false activation 0, evidence resolution 1.0 and second-scan reduction 1.0.

limitations: The review was read-only; no files were written and no external benchmark ran.
Range truth, fixture, and scorer content was not read.
Full test results of 1941 passed and 7 skipped were accepted from hash-bound local evidence; targeted read-only checks were independently executed for critical behavioral properties.
The local ignored wheel was accepted through its recorded hash, size and inventory rather than independently retained as review output.
The three historical P0 benchmark aggregates are absent from this worktree and were not represented as replayed.
Native Windows Black limitations and the successful WSL Black result were accepted from the qualification evidence.
